name: Itaúna do Sul (Brazil)
description: Vertical bicolour of dark blue and white, the blue about a quarter of the length, the white charged with the Southern Cross in dark blue stars edged in yellow.
history: Itaúna do Sul is a municipality in the state of Paraná, Brazil. Flags of the World records that the flag and arms were designed by Washington Batista de Souza, then a pupil at the Colégio Estadual Rui Barbosa, winner of a public contest held with the municipal chamber; the stars represent the seat and the districts, and the arms are placed on the flag overlapping the two fields. Portuguese Wikipedia dates the official adoption to bill No. 030/92.

features.role: Southern Cross, the stars edged in yellow, for the town and its districts
